notifications.accessDenied: You don't have permission to view this order.
notifications.cancelAutoReleaseFailed: Order was cancelled, but the auto-release of reserved stock failed. Use "Release Stock Manually" to retry.
notifications.createAutoAdvanceFailedBody: Order stays in the initial status. Open the detail page to transition manually.
notifications.createAutoAdvanceFailedTitle: Order created, but status change failed
notifications.deleteLinkedDRsFailed: Order deleted, but {{count}} linked delivery request(s) couldn't be removed. Delete them manually.
notifications.formDesktopOnly: Sales order create / edit is desktop-only. Open the page on a larger screen.
notifications.importEmpty: No items found in the file.
notifications.importMissingColumn: Missing required column(s): {{columns}}. Download the latest template.
notifications.importMissingColumnByName: Couldn't find the item-name and quantity columns. Make sure the sheet has a "Tên hàng" / "Item name" column and a "Số lượng" / "Quantity" column.
notifications.manualReleaseNoSnapshot: Cannot release: no reservation snapshot recorded for this order.
notifications.planFailureDiffUnderflow: {{sku}}: row holds {{currentReserved}} {{unit}} reserved but the edit would release {{requestedRelease}} {{unit}}. Inventory may have been adjusted out-of-band — reconcile and retry.
notifications.planFailureNoRow: {{productName}}: no inventory row at {{locationCode}}. Add stock there or pick a different location.
notifications.planFailureReleaseOverflow: {{sku}}: would release more than is reserved. Inventory may have been changed externally.
notifications.planFailureReservationMismatch: {{sku}}: reserved {{reserved}} doesn't match requested {{requested}}. Re-confirm the order.
notifications.planFailureUnknownProduct: Unknown product {{sku}} on order — remove the line.
notifications.planFailureUnknownUnit: {{sku}}: unit {{unit}} is not declared on the product.
notifications.reservationFailedDirty: Inventory writes left rows in an inconsistent state: {{rows}}. Manual reconciliation needed.
notifications.reservationFailedRolledBack: Inventory write failed and was rolled back: {{error}}

reconcile.behind: Deliveries are complete ({{count}} closed) but the order has not been marked as completed.
reconcile.behindBlocked: Deliveries are complete ({{count}} closed) but the order's current status cannot reach the completion status.
reconcile.blockedHint: No automatic repair available — the current status cannot reach the completion status (check status transitions in App Config, or move the order forward manually).
reconcile.confirmMessage: This replays the missing steps of the delivery chain (align the reservation, complete the order, deduct stock, release stray holds). Safe to re-run — steps already done are skipped.
reconcile.confirmMessageShip: This order recorded no inventory deduction. Repair will reserve and deduct its ordered quantities now. Confirm only if you are sure the stock was never deducted another way — repairing an already-deducted order would double-count.
reconcile.drift: The order's reservation snapshot does not match the inventory holds ({{count}} line(s)).
reconcile.notDeductedMissing: The order is completed but no inventory deduction was recorded for its lines.
reconcile.notDeductedReserved: The order is completed but its reserved stock was never deducted from inventory.
reconcile.nothingToRepair: Nothing to repair — the order is already in sync.
reconcile.orphans: Inventory rows still hold stock for this order although it no longer reserves ({{count}} line(s)).

shipRecovery.ambiguous: {{orderNumber}}: the reservation for {{items}} changed while the deduction was in flight, so it was not replayed. Use the reconciliation banner on the order.
shipRecovery.applied: {{orderNumber}}: an interrupted stock deduction was completed automatically.
shipRecovery.failed: {{orderNumber}}: could not finish the stock deduction ({{error}}). It will be retried next time the order is opened.
shipRecovery.pendingNotice: The stock deduction for this order was started at {{at}} but has not finished yet. Nothing is lost — the reserved stock is still held and the system completes the deduction automatically.
